name: Elementalist
theme: Apotheosis of the Transmuter. Conversion stacks beyond cap, every element-swap fuels Resonance, physical damage barely exists.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Conversion effects stack to 150% instead of 100%. Element-swap procs also reset the Resonance counter.'
Pairs with sorcerer.json elementalist path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Element Shifter + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Element Pulse.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 4 of 8 wireable today (incElementalDamage / incChaosDamage / procOnCrit applyTag(chill) / whileTag(shock) damageMult). Resonance-charge mechanic + conversion-stack-cap + Element Cascade cooldown action are decorative until Phase F.

nodes.name: Chaos Tap
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% chaos damage (Elementalist deals chaos via conversion procs — foundation scaler).

nodes.name: Spell Cycle
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15% chance to apply Chill (cross-element accelerator).

nodes.name: Resonant Crit
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to add a Resonance charge of a random missing element (Resonance accelerator).

nodes.name: Hybrid Mastery
nodes.description: Hybrid-damage skills (2+ damage types) deal +25% damage.

nodes.name: Element Cascade
nodes.description: On killing a Chilled enemy, +20/40/60% chance to refresh all skill cooldowns by 0.5s.

nodes.name: Element Shifter
nodes.description: Conversion effects stack to 150% instead of 100%. Element-swap procs also reset the Resonance counter (free Convergence cycles). The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
